boundary_records.summary: Live work/state TS ownership plus finite namespaced Rust decision candidates. No TS semantic kernel export, producer join, JS-Wasm ABI, bootstrap/selection, installed native or deployed consumer route. The native callable surface is Rust crate-level; observed callers are finite conformance witnesses, not real product reuse. Current work/state semantic owners remain TS.

Seven registered families contain decision implementations and embedded finite witnesses. Root comments supersede stale leaf comments claiming unregistered standalone files. Cargo registration is partial W04.4 progress, not original all-prerequisite completion or ABI/adoption. Leaf U16/Value/Error/Row types intentionally remain namespaced; only crate-private numeric_text is shared.
boundary_records.gate: W04.4 remains unclosed in original task ledger; native-conformance tracked candidate evidence does not waive W03.4

boundary_records.summary: Preserve owning public TS shells; select only a qualified small pure decision family operating on inert, lossless, already-demanded facts. Reuse existing producer seam and one startup-selected synchronous adapter only after real caller benefit, instead of generic bridge/interface or whole-kernel protocol. First candidates are scalar policy/time predicates or closed lifecycle/fanout planning facts; no authorization verdict, JS callback, arbitrary payload, storage or scheduler ownership crosses. No default switch or TS retirement.
boundary_records.status: proposal; no implementation or new accepted semantic decision

boundary_records.summary: TS owns arbitrary-object/getter/proxy demand and original thrown value; demand-ordered random/evidence/supplier/derivation calls, clock/claim minting, optional availability, auth/grants/content reads, hash identity, live membership/checkpoints, observed revisions and one conditional commit. Current candidates with Fn/RandomPort need a host split before JS-Wasm export; do not eagerly pre-collect facts or rerun side effects in shadow/fallback.

Do not blanket merge Value/U16/row/error preludes: work safety traversal, state clone-only and passthrough provider data have distinct observable domains. Native owned trees do not represent all JS cycles/proxies/getters; lifecycle Map/Set, receipt Undef/Func tags and rows Rc alias tracking differ. A shared helper is justified only with exact finite domain/profile equivalence; namespace registration performs no structural conversion.

Commands stage via reader-only load/query context; state registry owns readRevision/staging/output checks and single store commit; join assertions own structural batch eligibility, storage owns fenced revision/version and actual serialized bytes. Cloudflare driver orchestrates providers, fresh fences and act-time evidence rereads. Rust outputs can only propose decisions/batches, never claim current authority or commit.

State fanout shape/lifecycle/membership/progress calls run through real producer-load source seams in Cloudflare F7; they are TS source consumers, not kernel consumers or default installed scheduler proof. Work classifier/planner/commands are injected structurally and concrete donor bindings are observed in tests. Named wait API absent; held/awaiting states are not successful wait completion.
boundary_records.limits: Memory winner tests and Miniflare D1/workerd DO harnesses remain tests; installed/deployed/native qualifications need own evidence.

boundary_records.summary: Original W01 state receipt work-loader path was replaced by public @canlang/work/receipt loadWorkReceiptFns. Exact absent observer-module-only fallback is real conditional Node/source consumption; broken observer remains loud. VENDOR_TREES has state/values but no work or work-kernel, so this fallback is not proven packaged Worker closure. Historical excluded state loader keys are stale after relocation; do not label all current receipt consumption test-only.

No wasm_bindgen/no_mangle/extern C/JS generated glue/backend selector exists in work-kernel sources; host-values is TS test-only lifetime scaffolding, not adapter. Distribution modules descriptor publishes TS directory only; generic package asset tooling elsewhere does not establish Work-specific binary bootstrap.
